title: Death from Afar
description: When you **enter a combat situation**, gain Aim equal to your DEX (min 1). You can spend 1 Aim to do one of the maneuvers below. When the combat situation ends, lose all Aim.

bullets: **Line It Up** — Your next ranged attack gains **piercing** and ignores cover and concealment
**Rapid Shots** — Your next ranged attack gains **area** and either **hand**, **close**, **near**, or **far**
**Suppressing Fire** — **Aid A PC** without paying another cost; if they take dmg, reduce it by 1 (min 1)
**Take Cover** — After you **Trade Blows** at range, reduce dmg taken by your DEX (min 0)

title: Find Weakness
description: You may **Sense Motive**+DEX by observing them in a battle or physical contest. If you do so, no matter the roll you may also ask one question about their strengths and weaknesses.

title: Sniper Nest
description: When you **spend minutes or hours (GM's call) finding or creating the perfect vantage point**, you gain the following benefits while there:

bullets: Once a combat situation begins, gain +1 Aim (max 4)
The first time you attack with a ranged weapon from it, no one new learns your position
Trap kits set up here deal 1d6 dmg instead of 1d4 and never impede or harm you or your allies

outcomes.text: When you leave the nest, lose its benefits unless you spend time setting it up again. If you need to **Defy Danger** to leave it safely, roll with **adv**.

title: Spotter
description: When you **receive** **Aid** **while attacking with a ranged weapon**, instead of gaining **adv** on a roll you may execute one maneuver without spending Aim.

title: Trick Arrows
description: You may spend Aim or mark a use of the appropriate item to do any of the following maneuvers on your next ranged attack:

bullets: adventuring gear — **forceful**, or pulls you to them or vice-versa
alchemical vials — +1 dmg and spreads acid, fire, or smoke
poisoner's kit — target takes +1 dmg until the end of the scene
trap kit — +1 dmg and briefly immobilizes your target
